q: 把视觉搜索的数据+embedding 摄取管线按正确顺序排列：
q_en: Order the visual-search data and embedding ingestion pipeline correctly:
scenario: 为 Pinterest Lens 式系统设计数据层：一张新图从爬取到进索引要经过哪些阶段。
scenario_en: Designing the data layer for a Pinterest Lens-style system: the stages a new image passes from crawl to index.
steps: 去重：pHash/dHash 粗筛→桶内 embedding 聚类→选代表图
摄取：爬取图像、抽取元数据
索引：ANN 建库(HNSW/IVF)、蓝绿部署、多模态元数据存储
安全过滤：NSFW+政策检测器→隔离/人工复核
embedding 生成：选架构、embedding 版本化、批量推理
why: 顺序：摄取→安全过滤(必须在 embedding 前，别把不安全内容白算白存)→去重→embedding 生成→索引。安全过滤前置是关键：放在最前才不浪费算力和索引容量在会被删的内容上。
why_en: Ingest, then safety-filter before embedding (so you never waste compute/storage on unsafe content), then dedup, then generate embeddings, then index.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  I[摄取] --> S[安全过滤] --> D[去重] --> E[embedding 生成] --> X[索引]

termDefinitions.meaning: 用选定编码器把图像批量编码成向量，是数据层最高杠杆的决策(决定向量空间质量)。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Embedding generation encodes images into vectors with a chosen encoder, the highest-leverage data-layer decision as it sets vector-space quality.

termDefinitions.meaning: 管线入口：爬取图像并抽取元数据(标题/标签/价格等)。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Ingestion is the pipeline entry: crawling images and extracting metadata (title, tags, price).

scenario: 移动端视觉搜索，延迟预算极紧(需 ~10ms 编码)、微调预算有限，主要做同域内图搜图。
scenario_en: Mobile visual search with a very tight latency budget (~10ms encode), limited fine-tuning budget, mostly in-domain image-to-image.
q: 该选哪种 embedding 编码器？
q_en: Which embedding encoder should you pick?
why: 选 ResNet：卷积自带平移不变性等强归纳偏置，预训练 checkpoint 收敛快、微调成本低，推理约 10ms/GPU 适合移动端延迟约束。代价是跨域泛化弱、无原生文本，跨模态要另配文本编码器。
why_en: Pick ResNet: convolutional inductive biases and fast-converging pretrained checkpoints give low fine-tune cost and ~10ms inference, fitting the mobile latency budget.
tradeoff: ResNet(约 10ms、微调便宜) vs ViT/CLIP(更准/跨模态但 30–50ms、更贵)
whenOtherWins: 若要跨域泛化或原生图文跨模态检索(图搜商品)，CLIP 更合适；若不缺预训练数据、追求大规模图搜图精度上限，ViT 更合适。
options: ResNet：强归纳偏置、微调便宜、约 10ms/GPU 推理，适配移动端延迟约束
CLIP：因为它零样本跨模态最强，延迟不重要
ViT：因为大 benchmark 精度最高，移动端也该用最准的
都不选，直接暴力像素比对省掉编码器
options_en: ResNet: strong inductive biases, cheap fine-tuning, ~10ms/GPU inference, fitting the mobile latency budget.
CLIP: because it is best at zero-shot cross-modal, and latency does not matter.
ViT: because it has the highest large-benchmark accuracy, so mobile should use the most accurate too.
None: just do brute-force pixel comparison and skip the encoder.
optionExplanations: 对；移动端延迟约束是硬约束，ResNet 的约 10ms 推理+低微调成本+同域够用，正好卡这个 profile。
错；场景是同域图搜图且延迟极紧，CLIP 的 30–50ms 超预算、跨模态能力这里也用不上。
错；ViT 约 20–40ms 且 data-hungry，移动端延迟和微调预算都不允许，精度最高≠这里最合适。
错；像素比对不具语义、也不省算力，十亿级更不可行，答非所问。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — the mobile latency budget is a hard constraint, and ResNet's ~10ms inference plus low fine-tune cost plus in-domain sufficiency fits this profile exactly.
Wrong — the scenario is in-domain image-to-image with a very tight budget, where CLIP's 30–50ms overshoots and its cross-modal power is unused.
Wrong — ViT at ~20–40ms and data-hungry violates both the mobile latency and fine-tune budgets; highest accuracy is not most-fit here.
Wrong — pixel comparison lacks semantics, saves no compute, and is infeasible at a billion scale, missing the point.

termDefinitions.meaning: 残差卷积网络，靠卷积的平移不变性等强归纳偏置，微调成本低、推理快，适合延迟约束场景。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ResNet (Residual Network) is a convolutional net whose inductive biases like translation invariance make it cheap to fine-tune and fast to run, fitting latency-constrained settings.

termDefinitions.meaning: 模型结构自带的先验假设(如 CNN 的平移不变性)，让它用更少数据学得更快。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An inductive bias is a structural prior a model carries (e.g. CNN translation invariance) that lets it learn faster with less data.

scenario: 图搜商品，需要跨域(真实照片↔目录图)且原生支持图文跨模态检索，微调资源较充足。
scenario_en: Image-to-product needing cross-domain (real photo↔catalog) and native image-text cross-modal retrieval, with ample fine-tune resources.
q: 这种跨模态场景该选哪种编码器？
q_en: Which encoder fits this cross-modal scenario?
why: 选 CLIP：双编码器(图+文)用对比学习训进共享潜空间，天然支持零样本跨模态检索、跨域泛化好。代价是约 30–50ms、微调吃资源，且只微调图像编码器会 alignment drift。这里跨模态是核心需求，CLIP 最匹配。
why_en: Pick CLIP: its dual image-text encoders trained contrastively into a shared latent space give native zero-shot cross-modal retrieval and strong cross-domain generalization.
tradeoff: CLIP(原生跨模态/跨域强) vs ResNet(快但无文本、跨域弱)
whenOtherWins: 若延迟预算极紧且只做同域图搜图，ResNet 的约 10ms 更合适；不需要文本模态时上 CLIP 是浪费。
options: ResNet：最快，跨模态可以后面再拼个文本编码器凑合
ViT：精度最高，跨模态需求可以忽略
CLIP：双编码器对比学习进共享潜空间，原生零样本跨模态+跨域泛化强，正合此场景
随便选，编码器对跨模态检索没有影响
options_en: ResNet: fastest, and cross-modal can be bolted on later with a text encoder.
ViT: highest accuracy, and the cross-modal need can be ignored.
CLIP: dual encoders contrastively trained into a shared latent space, native zero-shot cross-modal plus strong cross-domain, fitting this scenario.
Any encoder; it makes no difference to cross-modal retrieval.
optionExplanations: 错；ResNet 无原生文本，硬拼文本编码器还要额外对齐层，跨模态不是它的强项，事倍功半。
错；场景核心就是跨模态，忽略它等于答错题；ViT 也无原生多模态。
对；共享潜空间让图和文本可直接比对，跨域泛化又好，恰好命中图搜商品的跨模态核心需求。
错；编码器决定向量空间是否跨模态可比，选错直接决定能不能做图文检索，影响巨大。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — ResNet has no native text; bolting on a text encoder plus an alignment layer is not its strength, a lot of effort for little.
Wrong — the scenario's core is cross-modal, so ignoring it answers the wrong question, and ViT also lacks native multi-modality.
Correct — the shared latent space lets image and text be compared directly with good cross-domain transfer, hitting image-to-product's cross-modal core need.
Wrong — the encoder decides whether the vector space is cross-modal comparable, so the choice directly governs whether image-text retrieval works, a huge impact.

termDefinitions.meaning: 双编码器(图+文)对比学习模型，把图文映射进共享潜空间，支持零样本跨模态检索。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: CLIP (Contrastive Language-Image Pretraining) is a dual image-text encoder trained contrastively into a shared latent space for zero-shot cross-modal retrieval.

termDefinitions.meaning: 无需在目标任务上微调即可直接检索，靠预训练学到的通用图文对齐。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Zero-shot retrieval works without task-specific fine-tuning, relying on general image-text alignment learned in pretraining.

scenario: 要在 ResNet、ViT、CLIP 之间按泛化、微调成本、多模态能力做取舍，而非排名。
scenario_en: You must trade off ResNet, ViT, and CLIP on generalization, fine-tune cost, and multi-modality, not rank them.
q: ResNet / ViT / CLIP 在泛化、微调成本、多模态上如何对比？
q_en: How do ResNet, ViT, and CLIP compare on generalization, fine-tune cost, and multi-modality?
why: ResNet：同域内泛化好、微调便宜、无多模态，适合移动端延迟约束；ViT：大预训练下泛化强、微调中等、无原生多模态，适合大规模图搜图；CLIP：零样本跨域最强、微调贵、原生图文，适合跨模态/图搜商品。是三条 profile 的取舍不是排名。
why_en: ResNet is good in-domain, cheap to fine-tune, no multi-modal (mobile); ViT is strong with large pretraining, medium cost, no native multi-modal (large-scale image-to-image); CLIP is best zero-shot cross-domain, expensive, native image-text (cross-modal).
tradeoff: ResNet(便宜快、同域) vs ViT(准但 data-hungry) vs CLIP(跨模态但贵)
options: 三者优劣绝对：CLIP 永远最好，其次 ViT，ResNet 最差
ResNet 同域好/微调低/无多模态；ViT 泛化强/成本中/无原生多模态；CLIP 零样本跨域优/成本高/原生图文
三者能力完全相同，选哪个只看代码好不好写
ViT 微调最便宜、数据需求最低，任何场景都优先选它
options_en: There is an absolute ranking: CLIP is always best, then ViT, then ResNet worst.
ResNet is in-domain/low cost/no multi-modal; ViT is strong-generalization/medium cost/no native multi-modal; CLIP is zero-shot cross-domain/high cost/native image-text.
All three are identical in capability; choose by which is easiest to code.
ViT is cheapest to fine-tune with the lowest data need, so always prefer it.
optionExplanations: 错；不存在绝对排名，本课明确说是按延迟/规模/微调资源匹配 profile 的取舍。
对；每种架构有清晰的 profile，按延迟预算、索引规模、微调资源匹配，而非分高下。
错；三者能力差异巨大(跨模态/泛化/成本),不是编码难易问题。
错；ViT 恰恰 data-hungry、微调成本中等，不是最便宜也非万能首选。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — there is no absolute ranking; the lesson says to match a profile by latency/scale/fine-tune resources as a trade-off.
Correct — each architecture has a clear profile, matched by latency budget, index scale, and fine-tune resources rather than ranked.
Wrong — the three differ enormously (cross-modal/generalization/cost), not a coding-ease question.
Wrong — ViT is actually data-hungry with medium fine-tune cost, neither cheapest nor a universal default.

termDefinitions.meaning: 视觉 Transformer，用自注意力让每个 patch 关注全局，大预训练下检索精度高但 data-hungry。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ViT (Vision Transformer) uses self-attention so every patch attends globally, giving high retrieval accuracy with large pretraining but is data-hungry.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一个特征能看到的输入范围；ViT 靠自注意力实现全局感受野，CNN 靠堆卷积逐层扩大。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The receptive field is how much input a feature can see; ViT gets a global one via self-attention while CNNs grow it by stacking convolutions.

scenario: 用领域数据微调 CLIP 提升目录检索，但为省事只微调了图像编码器，文本编码器冻结不动。
scenario_en: Fine-tuning CLIP on domain data to improve catalog retrieval, but to save effort only the image encoder is trained while the text encoder is frozen.
q: 只微调 CLIP 的图像编码器会导致什么问题？
q_en: What problem arises from fine-tuning only CLIP's image encoder?
why: alignment drift：图像 embedding 在微调中漂移，而文本 embedding 冻结不动，两个空间失去对齐→跨模态余弦不再可靠，图文检索退化。要么图文联合微调(两空间一起动、保持对齐)，要么用 adapter 层限制漂移。
why_en: Alignment drift: the image embeddings shift during fine-tuning while the text embeddings stay fixed, desyncing the two spaces so cross-modal cosine becomes unreliable.
tradeoff: 只微调图像编码器(省事但 drift) vs 图文联合微调(保持对齐但成本高)
diagram:
flowchart LR I[图像编码器
微调后漂移] -.失去对齐.-> T[文本编码器
冻结不动] I --> X[跨模态余弦不可靠]
options: 没问题，只动图像编码器更省算力，检索质量不受影响
会让文本编码器过拟合，图搜图反而变差
alignment drift：图像 embedding 漂移、文本冻结，两空间失对齐→跨模态余弦不可靠，图文检索退化
会导致模型无法收敛，训练直接崩溃
options_en: No problem; training only the image encoder saves compute and retrieval quality is unaffected.
It overfits the text encoder and makes image-to-image worse.
Alignment drift: image embeddings shift while text is frozen, desyncing the two spaces so cross-modal cosine is unreliable and image-text retrieval degrades.
It prevents the model from converging and training crashes outright.
optionExplanations: 错；省了算力却毁了对齐，跨模态检索质量恰恰受重创，不是不受影响。
错；文本编码器是冻结的不会过拟合，问题出在图像侧漂移离开了文本空间。
对；共享空间的价值靠两侧对齐维持，单动一侧就撕裂对齐，跨模态余弦失真是直接后果。
错；训练照常收敛，问题是收敛到一个与文本空间错位的图像空间,不是崩溃。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — it saves compute but wrecks alignment, so cross-modal retrieval quality is badly hurt, not unaffected.
Wrong — the text encoder is frozen and cannot overfit; the issue is the image side drifting away from the text space.
Correct — the shared space's value depends on both sides staying aligned, so moving only one tears the alignment and distorts cross-modal cosine.
Wrong — training converges fine; the problem is converging to an image space misaligned with the text space, not a crash.

termDefinitions.meaning: 只微调 CLIP 一侧编码器使图、文 embedding 空间不再对齐，跨模态相似度失真。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Alignment drift is when fine-tuning only one CLIP encoder desyncs the image and text embedding spaces, distorting cross-modal similarity.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在冻结主干上插入的小可训练层，以低成本适配领域并限制对齐漂移。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An adapter layer is a small trainable layer inserted on a frozen backbone to adapt to a domain cheaply while limiting alignment drift.

scenario: 红色皮革钱包和红色皮革手袋在 embedding 空间里几乎重合，但它们是不同品类。
scenario_en: A red leather wallet and a red leather handbag sit almost on top of each other in embedding space, yet are different categories.
q: 为什么只靠视觉相似度做检索不够，要怎么补？
q_en: Why is visual similarity alone insufficient, and how do you fix it?
why: 纯视觉 embedding 会把'看起来像'的错品类拉到一起(红钱包≈红手袋)，检回对但不对款。补法：两阶段——检索只用视觉快速取候选，重排再融合文本相关性(品类/元数据)把错品类压下去。视觉负责快召回，文本负责纠品类。
why_en: Pure visual embeddings pull look-alike wrong categories together (wallet≈handbag), so add a re-ranking stage that fuses text relevance to correct the category.
tradeoff: 只用视觉(快但混品类) vs 加文本重排(纠品类但多一阶段成本)
options: 只靠视觉就够，红钱包和红手袋本来就该算相似
换更大的图像编码器就能区分品类，不需要文本信号
纯视觉会把错品类拉到一起(红钱包≈红手袋)；用两阶段+文本重排融合品类/元数据纠正
把相似度阈值调到极高，只留一模一样的图,品类问题自然消失
options_en: Visual alone is enough; a red wallet and a red handbag should count as similar anyway.
A bigger image encoder can tell categories apart, so no text signal is needed.
Pure visual pulls wrong categories together (wallet≈handbag); a two-stage pipeline with text re-ranking fuses category/metadata to fix it.
Set the similarity threshold extremely high to keep only identical images, and category issues vanish.
optionExplanations: 错；用户要的是对的品类不是纯视觉像，把钱包当手袋推正是要避免的失败。
错；再大的视觉模型也难仅凭外观分清同色异类,文本元数据是更直接的品类信号。
对；视觉快召回+文本重排纠品类分工明确，直接解决 look-alike 错品类问题。
错；阈值拉到极高会暴增空结果、扼杀召回，且同色异类仍可能极相似,治标不治本。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — users want the correct category, not mere visual likeness, and pushing a wallet as a handbag is exactly the failure to avoid.
Wrong — even a bigger visual model struggles to separate same-color different-category by appearance alone; text metadata is a more direct category signal.
Correct — visual for fast recall plus text re-ranking for category correction is a clean split that directly solves look-alike wrong categories.
Wrong — an extreme threshold explodes zero-results and kills recall, and same-color different-category can still look nearly identical, treating symptoms not cause.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在视觉检索候选上再融合文本相关性等信号重新排序,纠正纯视觉的错品类。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Multi-modal re-ranking rescores visual-retrieval candidates by fusing text relevance and other signals, correcting pure-visual category errors.

scenario: 检索要在十亿向量里 <10ms 出候选,重排要在小候选集上精排且落在 10–30ms 预算。
scenario_en: Retrieval must return candidates from a billion vectors in <10ms, while re-ranking must precisely reorder a small set within a 10–30ms budget.
q: 两阶段管线里,视觉和文本信号该怎么分工?
q_en: In the two-stage pipeline, how should visual and text signals be divided?
why: 检索阶段只用视觉 embedding:纯视觉余弦快、能在十亿向量里 <10ms 近似召回 top-k。重排阶段在小得多的 top-k(100–500)上融合视觉+文本(BM25 或轻量 cross-encoder),拼接分数过小 MLP/GBDT 得融合相关性,落 10–30ms。快而近似 vs 精而多模态。
why_en: Retrieval uses vision-only embeddings for a fast <10ms ANN recall of top-k, then re-ranking on the small top-k (100–500) fuses visual plus text via a small MLP/GBDT within 10–30ms.
tradeoff: 检索(视觉-only、快、近似、十亿级) vs 重排(多模态、精、小候选集)
diagram:
flowchart LR Q[查询图] --> R["检索: 视觉-only ANN
<10ms, 十亿级"] --> K["top-k 100-500"] --> RR["重排: 视觉+文本融合
10-30ms"]
whenOtherWins: 若候选集本就很小(千级以下)且延迟宽松,可跳过两阶段直接用多模态精排;两阶段的价值在十亿级召回必须先快后精。
options: 检索和重排都用视觉+文本全信号,保证每步都最准
检索只用文本 BM25,重排才引入视觉,反过来分工
检索用视觉-only ANN 在十亿级 <10ms 召回 top-k;重排在小候选集融合视觉+文本(MLP/GBDT),10–30ms
只做检索不做重排,靠视觉召回直接返回,省掉一阶段
options_en: Use full visual+text signals in both retrieval and re-ranking so every step is maximally accurate.
Retrieval uses text BM25 only and visual is added at re-ranking — the reverse division.
Retrieval uses vision-only ANN to recall top-k in <10ms at billion scale; re-ranking fuses visual+text (MLP/GBDT) on the small set within 10–30ms.
Do only retrieval and skip re-ranking, returning visual recall directly to save a stage.
optionExplanations: 错;十亿级用全信号精排跑不进 <10ms,重信号必须留给小候选集,否则延迟爆表。
错;十亿级用文本 BM25 主召回既慢又丢视觉主线,分工反了。
对;先用便宜的视觉余弦大规模快召回,再在小集合上花得起多模态精排,各自卡住自己的延迟预算。
错;省掉重排就回到纯视觉错品类问题(红钱包≈红手袋),质量代价太大。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — full-signal precise ranking over a billion cannot fit <10ms; heavy signals must be reserved for the small set or latency blows up.
Wrong — text BM25 as the billion-scale primary recall is slow and drops the visual main line, reversing the division.
Correct — cheap visual cosine for large-scale fast recall, then affordable multi-modal precision on the small set, each within its own latency budget.
Wrong — skipping re-ranking reverts to pure-visual category errors (wallet≈handbag), too large a quality cost.

termDefinitions.meaning: 先视觉-only ANN 快召回 top-k,再多模态重排精排小候选集,兼顾规模与精度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Two-stage retrieval first recalls top-k with vision-only ANN, then precisely re-ranks the small set multi-modally, balancing scale and precision.

termDefinitions.meaning: 经典文本检索打分函数,按词频/逆文档频率衡量查询与文档的相关性。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: BM25 (Best Matching 25) is a classic text-retrieval scoring function ranking query-document relevance by term frequency and inverse document frequency.

scenario: 重排阶段要把视觉相似度分和文本相关度分拼在一起,学一个融合相关性分,团队要在 MLP 和 GBDT 间选。
scenario_en: Re-ranking must fuse visual and text scores into one learned relevance, and the team chooses between an MLP and a GBDT.
q: 拼接视觉+文本分做融合打分,MLP 和 GBDT 怎么选?
q_en: To fuse visual and text scores, how do you choose between MLP and GBDT?
why: 把视觉分+文本分拼成特征向量喂一个小融合模型:MLP 端到端可微、能与编码器联合训、相关性更好但难调试;GBDT(LambdaMART)把分当表格特征,迭代快、可解释(特征重要性)、易调试,但不能联合训。按需要联合训还是要可解释来选。
why_en: Concatenate visual and text scores into a small fusion model: an MLP is end-to-end differentiable and jointly trainable but harder to debug, while a GBDT is fast to iterate and interpretable but not jointly trainable.
tradeoff: MLP(可微/可联合训/难调试) vs GBDT(可解释/迭代快/不能联合训)
whenOtherWins: 若想端到端与编码器联合优化、追求相关性上限,选 MLP;若要快速迭代、特征可解释、易线上调试,选 GBDT。
options: MLP:端到端可微、能与编码器联合训、相关性更好但难调试;GBDT:迭代快、可解释、易调试但不能联合训
两者完全等价,随便选,融合效果一样
GBDT 是深度模型可端到端联合训,MLP 是树模型不能微分
只能用规则加权求和,MLP 和 GBDT 都不适合做融合
options_en: MLP: end-to-end differentiable, jointly trainable with encoders, better relevance but harder to debug; GBDT: fast to iterate, interpretable, easy to debug but not jointly trainable.
They are equivalent; pick either and fusion works the same.
GBDT is a deep model trainable end-to-end, and MLP is a tree model that cannot differentiate.
Only rule-based weighted sums work; neither MLP nor GBDT suits fusion.
optionExplanations: 对;两者是不同取舍轴——要联合优化/相关性上限选 MLP,要可解释/快迭代/易调试选 GBDT。
错;二者在可微性、可解释性、能否联合训上差别明显,不是随便选。
说反了;MLP 才是可微的神经网络,GBDT 是梯度提升树、不能与编码器端到端联合训。
错;规则加权太死板学不到复杂交互,MLP/GBDT 正是为学融合分而用,这条否定了正解。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — they are different trade-off axes: MLP for joint optimization and relevance ceiling, GBDT for interpretability, fast iteration, and easy debugging.
Wrong — they differ clearly in differentiability, interpretability, and joint trainability, not interchangeable.
Backwards — the MLP is the differentiable neural net, while GBDT is gradient-boosted trees that cannot train end-to-end with encoders.
Wrong — rule-based sums are too rigid to learn complex interactions; MLP/GBDT exist precisely to learn the fusion score, so this denies the right answer.

termDefinitions.meaning: 多层感知机,可微神经网络,可与编码器端到端联合训练学融合相关性。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: MLP (Multi-Layer Perceptron) is a differentiable neural net trainable end-to-end with encoders to learn fused relevance.

termDefinitions.meaning: 梯度提升决策树,把分数当表格特征,迭代快、可解释,但不能与编码器联合训。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: GBDT (Gradient Boosted Decision Trees) treats scores as tabular features, fast and interpretable, but not jointly trainable with encoders.

scenario: 十亿级图库里,同一张图有大量精确重复,还有裁剪/加水印/调色的近重复。
scenario_en: In a billion-image library, exact duplicates abound plus near-duplicates from crops, watermarks, and color shifts.
q: 重复和近重复不处理会带来什么后果?
q_en: What happens if duplicates and near-duplicates go unhandled?
why: 精确重复白占存储、还挤掉结果多样性;近重复(裁剪/水印/调色)会虚高召回、让 top-10 全是几乎一样的图,惹恼用户。所以去重既省索引又提体验,是十亿级的关键管线问题。
why_en: Exact dupes waste storage and hurt diversity, while near-dupes (crops, watermarks, color shifts) inflate recall and fill the top-10 with near-identical images, frustrating users.
options: 重复无害,反而能加强热门图的曝光,不用处理
只影响存储成本,对检索结果质量没有任何影响
精确重复浪费存储+损多样性;近重复虚高召回、top-10 near-identical 惹恼用户,去重省索引又提体验
近重复会自动被 ANN 过滤掉,不需要专门去重
options_en: Duplicates are harmless and even boost exposure of popular images, so no handling is needed.
It only affects storage cost with no impact on retrieval result quality.
Exact dupes waste storage and hurt diversity; near-dupes inflate recall and fill the top-10 with near-identical results frustrating users, so dedup saves index and improves experience.
Near-duplicates are automatically filtered by ANN, so no dedicated dedup is needed.
optionExplanations: 错;重复堆曝光只会让结果单调、多样性崩,用户体验变差不是变好。
错;近重复直接毁 top-10 多样性,是结果质量问题不只是存储。
对;两类重复分别打击存储/多样性和召回/体验,去重是同时省成本、提质量的关键步骤。
错;ANN 只找最近邻,近重复恰恰是最近邻,会被原样召回,不会自动去掉。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — piling on exposure makes results monotonous and collapses diversity, worsening experience not improving it.
Wrong — near-dupes directly ruin top-10 diversity, a result-quality issue, not just storage.
Correct — the two dup types hit storage/diversity and recall/experience respectively, so dedup both saves cost and raises quality.
Wrong — ANN finds nearest neighbors, and near-dupes are exactly the nearest neighbors, so they get recalled as-is, not auto-removed.

termDefinitions.meaning: 非逐像素相同但内容几乎一样的图(裁剪/水印/调色),会虚高召回、损结果多样性。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A near-duplicate is not pixel-identical but nearly the same content (crop, watermark, color shift), inflating recall and hurting diversity.

q: 把两遍去重管线按执行顺序排列:
scenario: 十亿级图库要既高效又准确地去重,先粗筛再精聚类。
scenario_en: A billion-image library must dedup both efficiently and accurately, coarse-filter first then precisely cluster.
steps: 桶内计算两两 embedding 余弦相似度,低于阈值聚成一簇
用感知哈希(pHash/dHash)对全库做 O(1) 粗筛,分到哈希桶
每簇按质量(分辨率、无水印)选一张 canonical 代表图保留
why: 先用 pHash/dHash 做 O(1) 粗筛把候选分桶(便宜、能挡掉精确/近精确重复),再在桶内算两两 embedding 余弦精聚类,最后每簇按质量选 canonical 代表。先便宜粗筛再贵精算,是十亿级可行的关键。
why_en: First perceptual-hash the whole library O(1) into buckets, then compute pairwise embedding cosine within each bucket to cluster, then pick a quality canonical per cluster.
diagram:
flowchart LR H["pHash/dHash 粗筛
O(1) 分桶"] --> C["桶内余弦聚类"] --> R["选 canonical 代表"]

termDefinitions.meaning: 感知哈希:对图像内容算指纹,内容相近哈希也相近,O(1) 比对可快速筛重复。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: pHash (perceptual hash) fingerprints image content so similar images have similar hashes, enabling O(1) duplicate screening.

termDefinitions.meaning: 差值哈希:更轻量的感知哈希,按相邻像素梯度方向生成指纹。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: dHash (difference hash) is a lighter perceptual hash that fingerprints images by the gradient direction between adjacent pixels.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一个重复簇里按质量(分辨率、无水印)选出的唯一保留图。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A canonical representative is the single image kept per duplicate cluster, chosen by quality like resolution and no watermark.

scenario: 去重的相似度阈值要定:一个商品有 5 种颜色,理应各自出现;但裁剪/水印近重复该合并。
scenario_en: You must set the dedup similarity threshold: a product in 5 colors should each appear, but crop/watermark near-dupes should merge.
q: 去重阈值太激进(太紧)会有什么代价?
q_en: What is the cost of an over-aggressive (too-tight) dedup threshold?
why: 阈值太紧会把合法变体误合(5 色商品塌成 1 个),损失应有的多样性和商品覆盖。阈值太松又漏掉近重复、top-10 全一样。所以要在已知变体组的留出集上校验阈值,再上线。Pinterest 去重砍了约 15% 索引同时提升感知质量。
why_en: A too-tight threshold collapses legitimate variants (5 colors into 1), losing diversity and coverage, so validate the threshold against held-out known-variant groups before deploying.
tradeoff: 阈值太紧(误合法变体、损多样性) vs 太松(漏近重复、top-10 雷同)
whenOtherWins: 若库里几乎没有合法变体、只有纯拷贝(如证件照库),可用更紧阈值多去重;有多色/多角度合法变体时必须放宽并做变体组校验。
options: 太紧只会更干净,没有任何代价,能紧就尽量紧
太紧会把合法变体(如 5 色商品)误合成 1 个,损多样性/覆盖;要用已知变体留出集校验阈值
阈值和多样性无关,只影响去重速度
太紧会漏掉近重复,让 top-10 变得雷同
options_en: Tighter is only cleaner with no cost, so tighten as much as possible.
Too tight merges legitimate variants (e.g. 5 colors into 1), losing diversity/coverage, so validate the threshold on held-out known-variant groups.
The threshold is unrelated to diversity and only affects dedup speed.
Too tight lets near-duplicates through, making the top-10 look identical.
optionExplanations: 错;太紧会误杀合法变体,牺牲多样性与商品覆盖,代价真实存在。
对;紧阈值把该保留的多色变体塌掉,必须靠变体组留出集把阈值校准到既去重又保变体。
错;阈值直接决定哪些图被合并,深刻影响多样性,不只是速度。
说反了;漏近重复、top-10 雷同是阈值太松的后果,不是太紧。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — too tight kills legitimate variants, sacrificing diversity and product coverage, a real cost.
Correct — a tight threshold collapses multi-color variants that should stay, so a variant-group held-out set is needed to calibrate between deduping and preserving variants.
Wrong — the threshold decides which images merge and deeply affects diversity, not just speed.
Backwards — missing near-dupes and an identical top-10 is the consequence of too loose, not too tight.

termDefinitions.meaning: 同一商品的正当不同版本(多颜色/多角度),应各自保留而非被去重合并。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A legitimate variant is a valid different version of the same product (color, angle) that should be kept, not merged away by dedup.

scenario: 离线 recall 很高,但用户反馈 top-10 结果几乎一模一样(同图的不同裁剪/水印版)。
scenario_en: Offline recall is high, but users report the top-10 results look nearly identical (crop/watermark versions of one image).
q: 这个症状指向什么问题?
q_en: What does this symptom point to?
why: 去重相似度阈值太宽松(permissive):近重复没被合并,同一张图的多个版本一起挤进 top-10,recall 看着高实则多样性崩。修法是收紧阈值/补近重复检测,让每个内容只保留 canonical 代表。
why_en: The dedup similarity threshold is too permissive: near-duplicates were not merged, so multiple versions of one image crowd the top-10, inflating recall while diversity collapses.
options: 编码器太弱,换更大模型就能让 top-10 更多样
ANN 召回不足,加大 top-k 就能提升多样性
去重阈值太宽松:近重复没合并,同图多版本挤进 top-10,recall 虚高但多样性崩
延迟太高导致结果重复,优化速度即可
options_en: The encoder is too weak; a bigger model would diversify the top-10.
ANN recall is insufficient; increasing top-k would improve diversity.
The dedup threshold is too permissive: near-dupes were not merged, so one image's versions crowd the top-10, inflating recall while diversity collapses.
Latency is too high causing duplicate results; optimizing speed fixes it.
optionExplanations: 错;换大模型不解决重复项没被去掉的问题,近重复照样最近邻,top-10 仍雷同。
错;加大 top-k 只会召回更多同图版本,多样性更差不是更好。
对;症状(高 recall+雷同 top-10)正是去重太松的特征,收紧阈值/补近重复检测即可。
错;延迟与结果是否重复无关,速度救不了去重阈值太松。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — a bigger model does not remove un-deduped copies; near-dupes remain nearest neighbors and the top-10 stays identical.
Wrong — increasing top-k recalls more versions of the same image, worsening diversity not improving it.
Correct — the symptom (high recall plus identical top-10) is the signature of too-permissive dedup, fixed by tightening the threshold or adding near-dup detection.
Wrong — latency is unrelated to result duplication; speed cannot fix a too-loose dedup threshold.

termDefinitions.meaning: 去重相似度门槛太低,近重复不被判为重复,导致同图多版本共存于结果。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A permissive threshold is too low a dedup bar, so near-duplicates are not caught and multiple versions of one image coexist in results.

scenario: 评审问去重到底值不值得做,你要给一个可信的行业量级。
scenario_en: Review asks whether dedup is worth it, and you need a credible industry magnitude.
q: 去重能带来多大量级的收益?说明什么?
q_en: What magnitude of benefit does dedup bring, and what does it show?
why: Pinterest 报告去重砍了约 15% 索引规模,同时提升了感知质量(结果更多样)。这个约 15% 是经验观测,说明去重不是可选优化——它同时省存储/索引成本又提体验,是十亿级数据层的必要一环。
why_en: Pinterest reports dedup cut the index by about 15% while improving perceived quality, showing dedup both saves cost and improves experience, not an optional add-on.
options: 去重只省不到 0.1% 索引,基本没用,可以跳过
去重会让索引变大约 15%,是净成本,得不偿失
Pinterest 去重砍约 15% 索引同时提升感知质量,说明它同时省成本又提体验,是必要一环
去重收益无法量化,纯靠感觉,不值得投入
options_en: Dedup saves under 0.1% of the index, basically useless, so skip it.
Dedup grows the index by about 15% as a net cost, not worth it.
Pinterest's dedup cut about 15% of the index while improving perceived quality, showing it both saves cost and improves experience, a necessary step.
Dedup's benefit cannot be quantified, purely a feeling, not worth investing in.
optionExplanations: 错;约 15% 的索引缩减在十亿级是巨大存储/成本节省,远非可忽略。
说反了;去重是缩小索引不是增大,方向搞反。
对;约 15% 的经验数字把'省成本+提体验'量化,论证去重是数据层必要环节而非可选。
错;Pinterest 已给出约 15% 的可量化收益,并非无法衡量。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — a ~15% index reduction at a billion scale is huge storage/cost savings, far from negligible.
Backwards — dedup shrinks the index, not grows it; the direction is reversed.
Correct — the ~15% empirical figure quantifies 'save cost plus improve experience,' arguing dedup is a necessary data-layer step, not optional.
Wrong — Pinterest gives a quantifiable ~15% benefit, so it is not unmeasurable.

termDefinitions.meaning: 去重去掉冗余图后索引规模的下降比例(Pinterest 约 15%),直接省存储与检索成本。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Index reduction is the drop in index size after dedup removes redundant images (Pinterest ~15%), directly saving storage and retrieval cost.

scenario: 要给十亿级图库加 NSFW/政策过滤,有人提议在检索返回结果后再过滤,反正最终会挡住。
scenario_en: Adding NSFW/policy filtering to a billion-image library, someone proposes filtering after retrieval returns results since it blocks in the end anyway.
q: 安全过滤该放在管线的哪一步?
q_en: Where in the pipeline should safety filtering sit?
why: 放在 embedding+索引之前的摄取阶段做上游门禁:过滤放在索引后会白白在不安全内容上耗存储/算力/索引容量;而检索后过滤一旦失败或延迟抖动,不安全内容就直达用户。前置门禁既省资源又堵住泄露路径。
why_en: Filter upstream at ingestion, before embedding and indexing: post-index filtering wastes storage/compute/index on unsafe content, and post-retrieval filtering lets unsafe content reach users on any failure.
tradeoff: 上游门禁(省资源+堵泄露) vs 检索后过滤(白耗索引且失败即泄露)
diagram:
flowchart LR
  I[摄取] --> S{NSFW/政策检测}
  S -->|超阈值| Q[隔离/人工复核]
  S -->|通过| E[embedding+索引]
whenOtherWins: 对已受信、来源可控的私有目录(如自家审核过的商品库),前置门禁可轻量化;开放爬取内容必须严格前置。
options: 检索返回后再过滤,反正最终会挡住不安全内容,简单省事
放在 embedding+索引之前的摄取门禁:否则白耗索引资源,且检索后过滤失败即泄露给用户
过滤放在最后展示层的前端,让浏览器判断是否显示
不过滤,靠用户举报事后删除即可
options_en: Filter after retrieval returns, since it blocks unsafe content in the end, simple and easy.
Put it as an ingestion gate before embedding and indexing: otherwise index resources are wasted and post-retrieval filtering leaks to users on failure.
Filter at the front-end display layer and let the browser decide whether to show.
Do not filter; rely on user reports to delete afterward.
optionExplanations: 错;检索后过滤先把不安全内容 embedding、索引了,浪费资源,还留下过滤失败即泄露的窗口。
对;前置门禁在摄取就挡住,既不浪费下游算力/索引,又根除检索后泄露风险,是 Staff+ 的平台思维。
错;把安全判断丢给前端不可靠、易被绕过,不安全内容已进系统,门禁太靠后。
错;事后删除意味着不安全内容已触达用户,安全过滤必须前置预防而非补救。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — post-retrieval filtering first embeds and indexes unsafe content, wasting resources and leaving a leak window on filter failure.
Correct — an ingestion gate blocks at entry, wasting no downstream compute/index and eliminating post-retrieval leakage, the Staff+ platform view.
Wrong — delegating safety to the front-end is unreliable and bypassable, and unsafe content already entered the system, gating far too late.
Wrong — deleting afterward means unsafe content already reached users; safety filtering must prevent upstream, not remediate.

termDefinitions.meaning: 不适宜公开展示的内容(色情/暴力等),需在摄取阶段由分类器检出并隔离。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: NSFW (Not Safe For Work) is content unsuitable for public display (explicit/violent), detected and quarantined by a classifier at ingestion.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在管线早期(摄取)就拦截不合规内容,避免下游浪费资源与泄露风险。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An upstream gate blocks non-compliant content early (at ingestion), avoiding downstream resource waste and leakage risk.

scenario: 要在摄取阶段对每张图判 NSFW+政策违规(暴力/仇恨符号/版权),且不能拖慢管线太多。
scenario_en: At ingestion you must score each image for NSFW plus policy violations (violence, hate symbols, copyright) without slowing the pipeline much.
q: 上游安全过滤该用什么设计?
q_en: What design should upstream safety filtering use?
why: 用轻量二分类器(小/蒸馏 CNN)在摄取时对每张图打 NSFW+政策分:超阈值→进隔离队列人工复核;低于→放行进 embedding 管线。轻量是为了不拖慢十亿级摄取,人工复核兜住边界样本。
why_en: Use a lightweight binary classifier (small/distilled CNN) at ingestion to score each image for NSFW+policy: above threshold goes to a human-review quarantine queue, below proceeds to embedding.
options: 用一个几十亿参数的大模型逐张精判,慢一点没关系
轻量二分类器(小/蒸馏 CNN)摄取时打分:超阈值进隔离队列人工复核,低于放行进 embedding
靠关键词过滤文件名,不看图像内容
让用户上传时自己勾选是否安全,系统信任其声明
options_en: Use a multi-billion-parameter model to judge each image precisely; a bit slow is fine.
A lightweight binary classifier (small/distilled CNN) scores at ingestion: above threshold goes to a human-review quarantine queue, below proceeds to embedding.
Filter by keywords in the filename without looking at image content.
Let users self-declare safety at upload and trust their claim.
optionExplanations: 错;十亿级摄取用超大模型逐张精判会成瓶颈,过滤器要轻量才跟得上吞吐。
对;蒸馏小 CNN 快速打分、超阈值转人工复核,兼顾吞吐与边界样本的准确,是标准上游门禁设计。
错;文件名关键词绕不过改名,也看不懂图像内容,挡不住真正的违规图。
错;信任用户自我声明等于没有门禁,不安全内容会大量混入。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — a giant model judging each image at billion-scale ingestion becomes a bottleneck; the filter must be lightweight to match throughput.
Correct — a distilled small CNN scores fast and routes above-threshold to human review, balancing throughput and borderline accuracy, the standard upstream gate.
Wrong — filename keywords are defeated by renaming and cannot read image content, missing real violations.
Wrong — trusting user self-declaration is no gate at all, and unsafe content floods in.

termDefinitions.meaning: 被安全分类器判为可疑的图暂存于此,等待人工复核再决定删除或放行。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A quarantine queue holds images flagged suspicious by the safety classifier for human review before deletion or release.

termDefinitions.meaning: 由大模型蒸馏出的小卷积网络,推理快、成本低,适合摄取阶段高吞吐打分。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A distilled CNN is a small convolutional net distilled from a large model, fast and cheap for high-throughput scoring at ingestion.

scenario: 安全过滤阈值定太严,把医学影像、艺术裸体等合法内容也误判成违规删掉了。
scenario_en: The safety threshold is set too strict, wrongly removing legitimate content like medical imagery and fine-art nudes as violations.
q: 安全过滤的核心张力是什么,误报太多会怎样?
q_en: What is safety filtering's central tension, and what does over-flagging cause?
why: 核心张力是 false positive:太严会误删合法内容(医学影像、艺术),抬高空结果率(zero-result rate);太松又放不安全内容过关。安全过滤的误报率直接驱动 zero-result 指标。业界(Google SafeSearch)用分级阈值+边界样本人工复核折中。
why_en: The tension is false positives: too strict removes legitimate content (medical, fine art) and raises zero-result rate, while too permissive lets unsafe through, so tiered thresholds plus human review balance it.
tradeoff: 太严(误删合法、升 zero-result) vs 太松(放行不安全内容)
options: 没有张力,阈值越严越好,宁可错杀不可放过
核心张力是 false positive:太严误删合法内容、抬高 zero-result;太松放不安全内容;用分级阈值+人工复核折中
误报只影响存储,不影响任何检索指标
误报会降低延迟,所以其实是好事
options_en: There is no tension; stricter is always better, better to over-remove than let through.
The tension is false positives: too strict removes legitimate content and raises zero-result, too permissive lets unsafe through; balance with tiered thresholds plus human review.
False positives only affect storage, not any retrieval metric.
False positives reduce latency, so they are actually good.
optionExplanations: 错;宁可错杀会误删医学/艺术等合法内容,推高空结果率、伤害覆盖,不是越严越好。
对;误报把合法内容挡在门外直接抬高 zero-result,漏报又放不安全内容,分级阈值+人工复核是标准折中。
错;误删合法内容直接推高 zero-result rate,是明确的检索指标恶化,不只是存储。
错;误报与延迟无关,还会恶化覆盖与用户体验,绝非好事。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — over-removing kills legitimate medical/art content, raising zero-result and hurting coverage; stricter is not always better.
Correct — false positives bar legitimate content and directly raise zero-result while false negatives let unsafe through, so tiered thresholds plus human review are the standard balance.
Wrong — removing legitimate content directly raises zero-result rate, a clear retrieval-metric degradation, not just storage.
Wrong — false positives are unrelated to latency and worsen coverage and experience, far from good.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把合法内容误判为违规删掉,直接推高 zero-result rate、损害覆盖。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A safety false positive wrongly flags legitimate content as a violation and removes it, directly raising zero-result rate and hurting coverage.

termDefinitions.meaning: 对分类器判不准的边界样本引入人工判定,平衡误报与漏报。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Human-in-the-loop routes borderline classifier cases to human judgment, balancing false positives and false negatives.

scenario: 数据层各阶段不是孤立的,一个阶段的质量会传导到另一个阶段。
scenario_en: Data-layer stages are not isolated; one stage's quality propagates to another.
q: 数据层各阶段之间有哪些真实的相互影响?(多选)
q_en: Which real cross-stage interconnections exist in the data layer? (multiple)
why: 两条真实传导:①更好的 embedding→去重簇更紧(同物聚得更准);②安全过滤的误报率直接驱动 zero-result rate(误删合法内容=更多空结果)。这些串联说明数据层要整体设计,不能各管一段。
why_en: Better embeddings make dedup clusters tighter, and the safety-filter false-positive rate directly drives the zero-result rate, so the data layer must be designed as a whole.
options: 更好的 embedding → 去重簇更紧(同一物体聚得更准)
安全过滤误报率 → 直接抬高 zero-result rate(误删合法内容)
去重阈值 → 影响 top-10 结果的多样性
GPU 品牌 → 决定 embedding 的语义质量
options_en: Better embeddings → tighter dedup clusters (same object groups more accurately).
Safety-filter false-positive rate → directly raises zero-result rate (removes legitimate content).
Dedup threshold → affects the diversity of the top-10 results.
GPU brand → determines the semantic quality of embeddings.
optionExplanations: 对;embedding 空间更好,同物体距离更近,去重聚类更准更紧,是真实传导。
对;安全误报=误删合法图,合法内容变少直接推高空结果率,是明确的跨阶段影响。
对;去重阈值松紧直接决定 top-10 里保留多少同图版本,影响多样性。
错;GPU 品牌只影响算力/速度,embedding 的语义质量由模型与训练数据决定,与品牌无关。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — a better embedding space brings same objects closer, making dedup clustering more accurate and tighter, a real propagation.
Correct — safety false positives remove legitimate images, and fewer legitimate items directly raise zero-result, a clear cross-stage effect.
Correct — the dedup threshold's tightness decides how many versions of one image remain in the top-10, affecting diversity.
Incorrect — GPU brand only affects compute/speed; embedding semantic quality comes from the model and training data, unrelated to brand.

termDefinitions.meaning: 数据层一个阶段的质量或参数影响另一个阶段的指标,要求整体协同设计。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A cross-stage interconnection is when one data-layer stage's quality or parameter affects another stage's metric, demanding holistic design.
